name: Signal Cluster S58: Candlestick Patterns (All 26 + qstick)
description: Exercises: ALL candlestick pattern transforms — doji variants, hammer variants, engulfing, morning/evening star, marubozu, three soldiers/crows, qstick
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S58: All Candlestick Patterns
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
o = src.o
h = src.h
l = src.l
c = src.c

# === SINGLE-CANDLE REVERSAL ===
p_doji = doji(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_dragonfly = dragonfly_doji(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_gravestone = gravestone_doji(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_longlegged = long_legged_doji(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_fourprice = four_price_doji(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_hammer = hammer(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_invhammer = inverted_hammer(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_hanging = hanging_man(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_shooting = shooting_star(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_spinning = spinning_top(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_star = star(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)

# === MULTI-CANDLE REVERSAL ===
p_morning = morning_star(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_morningdoji = morning_doji_star(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_evening = evening_star(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_eveningdoji = evening_doji_star(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_engbull = engulfing_bull(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_engbear = engulfing_bear(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_abandbull = abandoned_baby_bull(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_abandbear = abandoned_baby_bear(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_3soldiers = three_white_soldiers(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_3crows = three_black_crows(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)

# === BODY SIZE ===
p_bigwhite = big_white_candle(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_bigblack = big_black_candle(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_marubozu = marubozu(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_whitemarub = white_marubozu(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_blackmarub = black_marubozu(period=10)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)

# === OSCILLATOR ===
p_qstick = qstick(period=10)(o=o, c=c)

# === REPORTERS ===
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Hammer'
    )
)((c, p_hammer))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Engulfing Bear'
    )
)((c, p_engbear))

xy_lines(
    title='QStick Oscillator',
    category='Momentum',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='QStick', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=p_qstick)
